Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed — each only where the geometry has room
   for it; one with nowhere to go is left out, never forced into the roadway.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE
Keep the uploaded image's composition, camera angle, geometry, buildings,
roads and permanent structures exactly as they are. Do not redraw,
reposition or restyle them. Change only what the sections below ask for.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1975
Post-Vietnam, oil crisis era. A brand-new mid-1970s strip mall — one low row of shops under a mansard-shingle canopy, fronted by an open parking lot.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- beauty salon with 'PERMS — SETS — WIGS' hand-lettered on the glass
- record shop with 'HI-FI — STEREO — 8-TRACK TAPES' window lettering
- low single-story buildings
- window signs: 'GRAND OPENING', 'COLD POP 20¢'
- a coin-operated kiddie ride by a storefront door
- a telephone booth at the edge of the parking lot
Typography: bold sans-serif, slab serif, occasional script.
Place each detail where it plausibly belongs — sidewalk, storefront, lot edge, under an overhang. If there is nowhere for one, leave it out; nothing stands in the roadway or a driving lane.

SIGNAGE RESTRICTION
The only readable text anywhere in the image is:
'PERMS — SETS — WIGS'
'HI-FI — STEREO — 8-TRACK TAPES'
'GRAND OPENING'
'COLD POP 20¢'
Do not render any other readable words, business names, slogans, advertisements, logos or brand names. Lettering that appears elsewhere must be too small, too distant or too weathered to read as words.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 18 people TOTAL: 7 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 6 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 5 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a woman waiting on a bench outside the beauty salon
- a shopper browsing the record store window
- a grandmother in cat-eye glasses carrying a church bulletin
Clothing: men in plaid patterns, wide lapels; women in midi skirts, peasant blouses. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 7 period vehicles, all different:
- 1968-1979 Chevrolet Nova — compact, simple three-box shape
- 1975-1980 Ford Granada — compact luxury, Mercedes-inspired formal grille
- 1975-1979 Chevrolet Monza — small hatchback, rare but present
- 1971-1978 Dodge Tradesman — boxy full-size van
- 1975-1978 Datsun 280Z — sleek fastback sports coupe
- 1968-1978 Volkswagen Beetle — rounded rear-engine economy car
- 1972-1980 Dodge D100 — angular cab, simple grille
Parked with gaps. Where a model is listed with a year range, render the 1975 model year specifically — only styling, trim and features available in 1975, nothing introduced later. No vehicle newer than 1975.
Parked vehicles sit nose-in or angled into the lot, evenly spaced; none parallel-parked along the street, none blocking a driveway apron. Keep the driveway aprons and the drive lanes through the lot clear.
PLACEMENT: three nose-in near the building; the rest in stalls at the far edge of the lot. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, no rumble strips
- utilities: overhead power lines everywhere, wooden utility poles standard

TREES
- crepe myrtle tree at parking lot island near entrance: a young tree, only about 10% of its canopy in the base image, thin trunk
- maple tree at landscape strip along the road: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 35% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- oak tree at back property line: clearly smaller than in the base image — about 75% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the base image.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
STRICTLY BLACK AND WHITE — true monochrome archival photograph, zero color anywhere.
Grain: visible fine grain. Style: documentary, natural light.
Photorealistic, like a preserved newspaper-archive frame; slight period-lens softness, not digitally sharp.
Light: bright open daylight, clear sky, soft natural shadows — a fine, ordinary day.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1968-1979 Chevrolet Nova — compact, simple three-box shape
1975-1980 Ford Granada — compact luxury, Mercedes-inspired formal grille
1975-1979 Chevrolet Monza — small hatchback, rare but present
1968-1978 Volkswagen Beetle — rounded rear-engine economy car
1972-1980 Dodge D100 — angular cab, simple grille
